reports.title: Designing Toward a Theory: An AI-Assisted Writing System as Design Experiment
reports.subtitle: A thirteen-month design experiment in applied systems science
reports.description: A case study of a thirteen-month design experiment in applied systems science: modeling the cognitive structure of expert long-form writing and building an AI-assisted environment — Systemic Writer — scaffolded around that structure rather than around text generation.
reports.author: Kurt Rowley
